states: Vite dev server serving this tree (based on PR 2622 head 1fe9f86d55) against a private DEMO_MODE mock backend (50 PVE nodes, 929 guests, 7 ESXi hosts, telemetry off), headless Chromium via Playwright; desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844.

Trends mode, 95 s per page counted per 30 s poll tick, before (base files swapped back under the same server) vs after: /vmware went from 1 /api/charts/infrastructure + 1 /api/charts/workloads read per tick to 0 + 1; /proxmox/overview from 2 + 2 to 1 + 1. Same on both viewports (95 s totals: vmware 4+4 to 0+4, proxmox 8+8 to 4+4).

Proxmox nodes table in Trends: every rendered node row draws its CPU, memory and disk sparklines (36 of 36 on desktop, 18 of 18 on phone), same as before; guest table sparklines unchanged (Proxmox 420 desktop / 108 phone, vSphere 54).
Bars mode on /proxmox/overview: node table shows no sparklines and the page makes no /api/charts reads.

Screenshots of both tables in Trends inspected at both viewports. The only failed request is the read-only demo refusing POST /api/usage/workload-history (403), the Trends activity ping, which this change does not touch.
interactions: Desktop: opened the View popover and switched Bars to Trends; phone: opened Filters, then View, and switched Bars to Trends. The Trends button reports aria-pressed=true and the switch triggers exactly one workloads read and one infrastructure read.
Navigated between /vmware and /proxmox/overview with Trends persisted and watched three poll cycles on each page.
Scrolled the nodes table into view before each capture.
